objective: Build feat/named-records: slugged directory and file names for Intent and Assignment records.
scope: Worktree worktree e, branch release/0.2.0/feat/named-records, based on release/0.2.0/fix/intent-lifecycle (PR #24, fe10dbb).
constraints: Never run the new CLI against the main checkout/.holyclaude: the installed 0.1.x CLI rejects slugged paths as corrupt. Test renames only in fixture directories under the scratchpad or test temp dirs.
Open Intents keep omitting state. No other record schema change. Slug length is path safety, not a content cap.
acceptance_criteria: Layout: .holyclaude/intents/<slug>-<intent-id>/intent.json and .holyclaude/intents/<slug>-<intent-id>/assignments/<slug>-<assignment-id>.json, slug from the record's own objective: lowercase, accents folded to ASCII, every non letter/digit run becomes '-', trimmed, cut at a word boundary around 40 characters; an empty slug leaves just the id; a slug never contains a separator or '..'; symlinks still refused.

The id stays the key: the loader takes the id from the end of the name (kind-<time>-<random>), the record's id must equal it, an Assignment's intent_id must equal its folder's id part; names without a slug (legacy ids such as intent-0001) still load.
When an objective changes, the directory or file is renamed in one move under the existing lock (git sees a rename); two paths holding the same id fail with an error naming both.
The root prompt's staging rule matches the Intent's directory by its id, and intent list prints each Intent's path.
README says collaborators need 0.2.0 (0.1.x reads slugged records as corrupt) and no longer promises that 0.1.x reads open Intents.

Tests: slug cases (accents incl. Portuguese, empty, long, separators), rename on update, legacy names, trailing-id matching, duplicate id across two paths, and a 0.1.0-style mismatch reported as corrupt; bundle rebuilt; fmt, lint, typecheck, full test pass.
result: E built: slug.ts (NFKD fold, [a-z0-9-], 40-char word cut), id matched at the end of names, CorruptRecord for mismatches and duplicate ids naming both paths, rename under the lock on write (directory moves with its Assignments), legacy names load, intent list path column, staging rule matches *<intent-id>/ byte-neutral, README compatibility note. 1256/0; bundle rebuilt.

acceptance.rationale: E verified by code review pntf, security review 6xw4 and narrow code/security re-reviews wmn1, xrti, cokb, 2ghh; final passes have no blockers.
